description: Baseline: static context proxy; deterministic quality gate exposed masked self_check failures in check-figures.sh.

asi.quality_bug: check-figures pipeline returned tail status because pipefail was absent
asi.benchmark_limit: nested headless Pi model calls fail in this shell environment; real subagent milestone runs remain required

description: Propagate self_check failures through check-figures.sh with pipefail.

asi.learning: The validator wrapper previously masked failures; enabling pipefail strengthens quality without affecting prompt load.
asi.transfer: General shell correctness fix, independent of benchmark workloads.

description: Split drawing implementation behind a compact public authoring facade.

asi.learning: Drawing workers need primitive names and composition contract, not 2,400 words of implementation; a facade cuts repeated four-worker context by 9,152 words (61.5% total proxy) while preserving runtime behavior.
asi.transfer: Progressive disclosure applies to every feature and figure type; implementation remains available only for debugging.

description: Replace the oversized lifecycle specimen with a minimal complete figure composition.

asi.learning: One small example is enough to teach import, paint order, labelled routing, nodes, terminal state, and write(); specialized content belongs in the brief and invariants.
asi.quality_risk: Milestone review must verify less example detail does not reduce sequence/UML figure quality.

description: Run shared figure validation and rasterization once after parallel drawing workers finish.

asi.learning: Per-worker checks raced on the same folder and repeated rasterization; one orchestrator check preserves the quality gate while reducing duplicated work.
asi.transfer: Independent of figure count, type, and benchmark feature.

description: Condense repeated drawing-worker invariants into a contract without removing rules.

asi.learning: The invariant file repeated explanations; compact positive rules preserve all shape, truth, label, and placement constraints while saving 124 words per worker.
asi.quality: All semantic categories and type-specific placement rules remain explicit.

description: Replace repository-tour prose with an adaptive compact evidence packet.

asi.learning: A fixed 1,500-word ceiling overproduces on small features; file-count budgets cap worker output while preserving entry, boundaries, types, value spine, state, externals, and anchors.
asi.transfer: Adaptive budgets scale from compact plugins to broad Rust features without benchmark-specific paths.
